title: smalldocs 0.1
subtitle: The first release
date: 2026-10-10
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

The first release of smalldocs builds websites from Quarto projects. It makes these parts of a site:

- pages with a navbar, a sidebar and a table of contents
- notebooks, with the outputs that were saved in them
- reference pages, made from the code of a package
- listings, with categories and a feed
- any Bootswatch theme, in a light version and a dark version

The command `smalldocs preview` builds the site again after each change. The command
`smalldocs publish gh-pages` puts the site on GitHub Pages.

smalldocs was made to build the documentation of a few projects without Quarto. It builds those sites
with the same pages, anchors and links as Quarto.
